messages:
liz: Quick sync — final release notes + internal announcement planned for Thu 18:00 UTC. Need: final copy sign-off, pin request, and explicit rollback lanes. Can we do a quick check?
sam: +1. I'll keep the blast short (4 bullets + tl;dr link). Who owns pin request in eng-all?
maria: I updated the RN doc with a short 'what changed' + migration notes. PTAL: https://docs.google.com/example-RN-draft
kyle: @ops-oncall can you confirm you'll monitor the canary and take rollback action if things go sideways?
ops-oncall: I'll be on standby Thu 17:30–19:30 UTC. I'll set alerts: error_rate > 3% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency increase > 100% from baseline. Share the exact metrics to hook into.
jordan: Rollback criteria suggestion: 1) error rate >= 5% over 5m OR 2) sustained p95 > 1.5s for 10m OR 3) user-facing failures in critical endpoints (chat/generate). Fallback lane: route to quantized-variant with pin fallback.
liz: Canary plan: 10% for 20m -> 50% for 20m -> full. If any threshold tripped, immediate 0% and roll back to previous pinned model. deploy-bot will post each step.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by liz at 2026-03-26T18:00Z. Steps:
```
# canary schedule (deploy-bot)
/deploy start --policy=canary --steps=10%,50%,100% --model=redwood-serve-v3@2026-03-26_18:00
/deploy pin --model=redwood-serve-v3 --to=2026-03-26_18:00  # after full
/deploy rollback --to=redwood-serve-v3@2026-03-25_21:00  # pre-release
```
Note: deploy-bot will post cues to this thread and to #eng-ops when each step begins.
maria: Draft internal blurb (short):
- TL;DR: Performance improvements and improved memory usage in text-generation. No API changes.
- Who: infra + runtime teams.
- When: Thu 18:00 UTC.
- Impact: brief canary rollout; fallback to previous model if errors.
Copy here if that looks good and I'll push to eng-all.
sam: Suggest tiny tweak to blurb: add link to RN and a one-line: "If you see regressions, ping @ops-oncall and the deploy thread."
kyle: I'll do the eng-all pin request at H-1 and post the deploy-bot cues at T-10. Who will send the short RN to support? @maria?
maria: I can send to support and paste the short RN into Zendesk template.
liz: Final checklist:
- [ ] RN doc review (maria)
- [ ] Pin request in eng-all (kyle)
- [ ] Canary monitor and alerts (ops-oncall)
- [ ] Support notify (maria)
- [ ] Deploybot schedule (liz)
If everyone is good I will finalize the blurb and schedule the pin. :thumbsup:
ops-oncall: Confirmed — will add Grafana dashboard link and set alert thresholds.
jordan: One more note: add a short testing snippet to RN to reproduce common edge-case prompt that caused latency spikes during staging.
maria: Added testing snippet to doc. Thanks.
liz: Great — I'll finalize and post the internal announcement at H-1. Thanks all. :rocket:
